It closed on the untoasted bread at 220 (0.042) and lifted it 4 cm (hold 228-270). While it gripped, the bread pushed the carriage to only 0.10-0.14. The fingers then slipped (fully closed at 264), and the bread dropped back onto its seat by ~288. The gripper went back to the bread/front area 410-513 (toaster contact, fingers closing 424-464 and 512) without moving a lever. 600-880 it worked at the toaster's right end, over the empty right slots (contact 683-881, close on nothing at 815), and again moved no lever. From ~950 to 2000 it hovered beside and above the toaster with closed fingers, with the bread in view at 1800-2000 (brief contact 1577-1583). The lever never exceeded 0.14, so the toaster was never on.
causal_chain: went for the bread first and pulled the untoasted slice up 4 cm (220-270) -> grasp slipped, bread fell back -> ~470 more steps of poking at the toaster top and right end without pressing a lever (410-881) -> hovered to the end -> toaster never on
self_recovery: none effective: after the slip it never targeted a lever handle.
